scope: Execution-boundary comparison before replacing armoured standoff group waypoint with selected-platform native orders

decisions.finding: Ordinary OperationCancel/Release call OperationRestore, VehicleReverseStep RELEASE and CortexGroupMoveClear. OperationRestore restores exact group attack policy, not selected native crew commands.
decisions.consequence: Replacing only CortexGroupMove with doMove would leave native orders without a selected-crew retirement contract.

decisions.finding: CortexGroupTick services vehicle leases through CortexVehicles lifecycle-only. CortexStop finishes ordinary driving and requests independent artillery crew retirement. Locality cancels previous generic operation before epoch replacement and separately resumes selected artillery retirement.
decisions.consequence: Selected-native cleanup cannot depend solely on a normal group tick that ends on stop/ownership change. It needs finite cleanup execution and explicit stop/locality/discovery wiring.

decisions.finding: CortexOwnershipLease rejects a nonempty selected artillery reference before driving retirement, even when ordinary expiry passes. Group-local driving pending journals also prevent acquisition.
decisions.consequence: A role-neutral selected-native reference must similarly block competing acquisition until real native retirement or proven supersession; expired lease metadata alone is insufficient.

decisions.finding: Artillery selected movement is already a finite original-seat ISSUE/REQUESTED/MOVING/HOLD/STOPPING/RETURNING lifecycle, with separate UNRESOLVED reservation, worker identity, baseline, original native reply/cleanup deadlines and physical rest checks. Its start/step policies are tied to artillery sessions and generations.
decisions.consequence: Use its executed lifecycle as the extraction reference, not an artificial artillery session or a call to support-only admission from armour.

decisions.finding: Current vehicle escape candidates contain one leg each. CortexSelectAvenue returns the chosen supplied route; selecting its last endpoint here does not discard intermediate legs because none are supplied.
decisions.consequence: No route-truncation fix is justified for this current caller.

implementationBoundary.required: One role-neutral original-seat finite selected-platform move/retire path, used by standoff and artillery rather than duplicate competing controllers. Original crew/native baseline/route, epoch, request/cleanup deadlines, exact worker identity and pending reservation survive cancellation. Artillery-specific session validation remains its policy boundary.
wiring: CortexVehicles standoff admission and existing tactical operation identity
CortexOwnershipLease acquisition exclusion for pending native selected work
CortexStop retirement request without outward resumption
CortexLocality old-worker retirement/incoming observer only from actual locality edge
Native readiness/reporting only after original command acknowledgement and measured physical outcome
mustNot: Do not start an unserviced doMove from the group waypoint branch.
Do not treat OperationCancel, expired lease or an ended script as native quiescence.
Do not mint artillery fire/session authority for armoured movement.
Do not create a permanently scheduled second movement controller or a dormant broker.
Do not replace unresolved selected crew with new actors just to unblock movement.

validation: Read-only source execution comparison. No new runtime implementation or behavioural acceptance, no new test and no package rebuild required.
